title: Maximum residue levels for folpet
summary: EU to increase MRLs for folpet on bananas and in honey from early 2027
update: The European Union (EU) will raise the maximum residue levels (MRLs) for folpet on bananas from 0.03 to 0.9 mg/kg, and in honey from 0.05 to 0.7 mg/kg. This follows a positive evaluation of their safety for consumers by the European Food Safety Authority.
what_changing: The EU will increase the MRL for folpet on bananas from 0.03 (the limit of determination, LOD) to 0.9 mg/kg, and in honey from 0.05 (LOD) to 0.7 mg/kg. (The LOD is the lowest level that can be detected using the most modern and reliable analytical methods.)
why: Following an application for a change of MRLs by the producer of folpet, the European Food Safety Authority evaluated the requested changes and concluded that increasing the MRL would not pose a risk for consumers ( EFSA 2026 ).
timeline: The new MRLs are expected to apply from early 2027.
background: MRLs are set in accordance with the rules set out in Regulation 396/2005 . For information on current MRLs for other substances, please consult the EU Pesticide Residues database .
resources: EFSA (2026) Setting of import tolerance for folpet in bananas and modification of the existing maximum residue level in honey . EFSA Journal, 24(7): e10168
title_fr: Limites maximales de résidus pour le folpet
summary_fr: L’UE va augmenter les LMR pour le folpet sur les bananes et dans le miel à partir du début de 2027
